title.ko: 비유적 구동사: come across · bring about · call off · put up with · give rise to · carry out
title.en: figurative phrasal verbs: come across, bring about, call off, put up with, give rise to, carry out

explain.ko: 구동사(phrasal verb)는 동사 + 부사/전치사로 이루어지며 문자 그대로의 뜻과 비유적 뜻을 가집니다. bring about(초래하다), call off(취소하다), put up with(참고 견디다), carry out(수행하다), come up with(떠올리다)처럼 비유적 뜻이 중요한 구동사가 많습니다. 일부는 목적어를 사이에 끼울 수 있고(call it off), 일부는 그럴 수 없습니다(look into it). 격식 있는 글에서는 한 단어 동사(cause, cancel, tolerate, perform)로 바꿔 쓰기도 합니다.
explain.en: Phrasal verbs consist of a verb + adverb/preposition and have literal and figurative senses. Many matter for their figurative meaning: bring about (cause), call off (cancel), put up with (tolerate), carry out (perform), come up with (think of). Some allow an object in the middle (call it off), others do not (look into it). In formal writing, a single-word verb (cause, cancel, tolerate, perform) can replace them.

notes.en: Three-part phrasal verbs like put up with cannot be split.

lines.t: Phrasal verbs combine a verb with an adverb or preposition to make a new meaning. Many have both literal and figurative senses, and learning the figurative ones enriches your expression. In formal writing, a single-word verb often replaces the phrasal verb.

trans.ko: 구동사는 동사와 부사 또는 전치사가 결합해 새로운 뜻을 만듭니다. 많은 구동사는 문자 그대로의 뜻과 비유적 뜻을 모두 가지고 있어, 비유적 뜻을 익히면 표현이 풍부해집니다. 격식 있는 글에서는 구동사 대신 한 단어 동사를 쓰는 경우가 많습니다.

prompt.ko: 비유적 구동사(bring about, call off, put up with, carry out)를 사용해 한 사건을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences about an event using figurative phrasal verbs (bring about, call off, put up with, carry out).

task.model: The bad weather brought about great disruption to the schedule. In the end the event was called off. Participants put up with the long wait. The organisers carried out an inquiry to find an alternative.

model_trans.ko: 악천후가 일정에 큰 혼란을 초래했어요. 결국 행사는 취소되었어요. 참가자들은 오랜 기다림을 참고 견뎠어요. 주최 측은 곧 대안을 마련하기 위해 조사를 수행했어요.
model_trans.en: The bad weather brought about great disruption to the schedule. In the end the event was called off. Participants put up with the long wait. The organisers carried out an inquiry to find an alternative.
